title: Maximum Value Of K Coins From Piles
description: Find the maximum total value of k coins collected from multiple piles where you can only take coins from the top of each pile.
pseudocode:
1. dp = new Array(k + 1).fill(0)
2. for pile of piles:
3.   for j from k down to 1:
4.     sum = 0
5.     for i from 0 to min(pile.length, j):
6.       if i > 0: sum += pile[i-1]
7.       dp[j] = max(dp[j], dp[j-i] + sum)

steps.note: Initialize DP array of size k+1 with zeros.
Taking 2 coins from pile: sum=101, dp[2] becomes 101.
